The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a workbench introduced with the [[Better Save Soul|Better Save Soul DLC]], that may be built in the [[Souls room]] after you unlock the [[Spiritualism (Tech Tree)|Beginner Healer]] technology. The {{PAGENAME}} allows you to use {{Item|Sin Shard}} to craft various items including '''enhancing organs'''. <br>
You can increase an [[Organs|organ's]] {{Skull|White}} or {{Skull|Red}} with the Organ Enhancer, use your [[Sin Shard|Sin Shards]] to create [[Boost fertilizer I|Boost]] and [[Quality fertilizer II|Quality fertilizers]] or craft the '''Soul Prayers'''.
